systems.system: Système d'information policière pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.platform: SIPAO, a police data management platform co-developed by INTERPOL with the region's countries, financed by the European Union
systems.owner: national authorities; implemented by INTERPOL until May 2025, formally transferred to national and regional authorities at Abuja on 8 April 2025
systems.tiers: for Côte d'Ivoire: the national centre (CTIP) in Abidjan; remote sites are counted for the region only (14 countries have connected remote sites), with no figure for Côte d'Ivoire

systems.system: Centre de traitement des informations policières (CTIP)
systems.country_label: CTIP, the DACORE of Côte d'Ivoire
systems.tiers: central, Abidjan; visited by INTERPOL's Secretary General on 18-19 February 2025

consulted from any SIPAO workstation; Côte d'Ivoire is one of four countries that have begun to feed INTERPOL's databases; 33,000 consultations of INTERPOL databases through SIPAO during the CAN 2023 in Côte d'Ivoire

note: INTERPOL's closing newsletter describes SIPAO regionally as a platform that digitises and exploits the information in police reports, and gives regional counts only (729,000 records by early 2025; 14 countries with remote sites; 15 with a national budget line, 5 of them funded) without naming Côte d'Ivoire in them; nothing says Ivorian stations enter reports or cases in it, so it is not classed as record and gives no fact.
